item.title: Portfolio Launch - AI-Powered Interactive Experience
item.description: Launched new interactive portfolio with custom AI agent trained on GitHub data. Features real-time project updates and intelligent conversation capabilities.
item.author: nithinjambula89@gmail.com (Nithin Jambula)
item.content:encoded:
Excited to announce the launch of my new interactive portfolio featuring a custom AI agent built from my GitHub repositories and professional data.

Key features:

  • Real-time project information updates
  • Interactive conversation about my experience and skills
  • Dynamic gallery showcasing latest work
  • Direct integration with 16fps multi-video generation platform

item.title: EchoSight Project - Vikas 2024 Innovation Award Winner
item.description: EchoSight, my wearable assistive navigation system for visually impaired users, wins Vikas 2024 Innovation Challenge. Patent pending for YOLO-based real-time object detection system.
item.author: nithinjambula89@gmail.com (Nithin Jambula)

item.title: 16fps Multi-Video Generation Platform
item.description: Completed development of 16fps autonomous video generation system using LangChain and Stable Video Diffusion. Commercial rights sold to media production company.
